overview: This Senate resolution commends public servants during Public Service Recognition Week, May 3 through 9, 2026, and throughout the year. It covers employees of federal, state, and local governments as well as members of the uniformed services, such as the military. The resolution praises their professionalism, recognizes their role in the economy, public safety, protecting individual rights, and democratic government, and calls on Americans to mark the week with events honoring them. It is symbolic and does not change any law, pay, or spending. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 14, 2026.
for: Supporters say government workers and service members provide essential services to millions of people and deserve public appreciation.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or the pay, staffing, or working conditions of public employees.
